review_method: Personally read all five complete canonical entries and viewed each replacement image at native size using view_image. Reviewed actor identity, sequence, objects, anatomy, monochrome crosshatching and semantic claims.

entries.observed_visual_details: The same moustached man claps beside two diners in the left panel, then runs away holding their food plate in the right panel. Repeated diners, tree and face establish sequence.
entries.semantic_anatomy_style_assessment: Resolves the former split-actor error. The trick is performed by one actor, with no community identifiers. Exaggerated running pose and two-handed plate grip are readable and anatomically plausible.
entries.recommended_alt: Two sequential panels show the same man clapping to distract diners, then running away with their plate of food.
entries.recommended_caption: An imagined sequence shows one person creating the distraction and taking the meal.

entries.observed_visual_details: The same curly-haired bearded man gestures boastfully at a meeting table, then bows his head and clasps his hands when an older visitor enters. The same seated colleague and table recur across a clear gutter.
entries.semantic_anatomy_style_assessment: Resolves the simultaneous-two-people ambiguity. Modern visitor is a valid imagined application of the brave-talk/timid-action contrast, not a claimed soldier or historical episode. Hands, faces and posture are coherent.
entries.recommended_alt: Two sequential panels show the same man boasting at a table, then lowering his head when an imposing visitor arrives.
entries.recommended_caption: An imagined meeting turns bold talk into timidity when a visitor arrives.

entries.observed_visual_details: A rueful man and a gesturing woman stand beside a broad low rectangular stone slab split into two flat pieces, small fragments and a separate horizontal cylindrical stone roller.
entries.semantic_anatomy_style_assessment: The source-specific grinding object is now correct, with no mortar cavity or upright pestle. The aftermath supports displaced anger without adding an active violent encounter. Ground contact and body anatomy are plausible.
entries.recommended_alt: Two people look toward a cracked flat stone grinding slab and its cylindrical roller beside a doorway.
entries.recommended_caption: An imagined aftermath shows a useful grinding slab damaged by misplaced anger.

entries.observed_visual_details: An overfull adult in a plain buttoned shirt braces a hand on his knee and rests the other on his covered belly, beginning to rise from a low stool with a prominent crack. Used dishes stand nearby.
entries.semantic_anatomy_style_assessment: The meal, bodily excess, cracked stool and effort to rise now follow the final interpretation. No caste identifiers, mocking audience or command to rise appear. The covered exaggerated belly conveys the literary hyperbole without portraying a community. Slight warm food-residue marks are a minor palette deviation, not a semantic defect.
entries.recommended_alt: An overfull diner begins to rise from a cracked low stool beside emptied meal dishes.
entries.recommended_caption: An imagined exaggeration shows the meal ending only as the diner rises from a cracked stool.
minor_notes: Faint warm food-residue marks; neutral gray would match the monochrome series more strictly.

entries.observed_visual_details: The same bespectacled moustached craftworker pays coins for decorative vases in the first panel; in the second he tips an empty pouch above his palm beside unfinished woodwork and bare shelves. The three vases recur behind him.
entries.semantic_anatomy_style_assessment: The sequence now directly conveys eager unnecessary spending followed by shortage. Repeated face, apron, pouch and vases link cause and consequence. No generic poverty or inherited character claim is introduced. Hands, exchange and empty-pouch action are clear.
entries.recommended_alt: Two sequential panels show a craftworker buying decorative vases, then examining his empty purse beside unfinished work and bare shelves.
entries.recommended_caption: An imagined purchase leaves the workshop short of money for later needs.

integration_requirement: Replace old graphic src and update alt/caption to the actual new scenes; current canonical metadata still describes old imagery. This review does not certify integration or publication.
scope_limit: No canonical files, source text, artwork or Git state changed; only this review written.
